summary: Dependency-confusion beacon on @grabcad scope exfiltrates host metadata at install time
details: @grabcad/preferences-client@0.0.1 is a near-empty package published under the @grabcad organization scope that self-describes as a 'Compatibility shim' and whose main module (index.js) returns a Proxy of no-op functions, providing no real functionality. The package.json postinstall script runs `node beacon.cjs`, and index.js fires the same beacon on require. beacon.cjs collects host identity and install context (hostname, install path, process.cwd(), process.version, and the npm/node user agent) and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The combination of a scoped-org stub with no legitimate function, automatic beaconing on install and on require, and a hardcoded non-registry bare-IP sink is the canonical dependency-confusion reconnaissance pattern: the artifact exists to be resolved by mistake inside an organization that uses the @grabcad scope internally and to disclose internal hostnames and filesystem paths to the publisher.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
